facts.P2_fcy_account: Mostly not needed: Montenegro uses the euro.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the Central Register of Business Entities (CRPS); steps not confirmed.
facts.L2_tax_id: PIB, an 8-digit tax number assigned when you register as an entrepreneur.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Residents are taxed on worldwide income; entrepreneurs have a separate scale.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 21% VAT above €30,000 in 12 months; exports are 0%.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.

watch_out.text: Once VAT-registered, you can't deregister for at least three years.
